column2: Meski buruk dalam berkata-kata, Littara akan berusaha sebisanya menyampaikan perasaannya padamu.

column1: =She looks forward to the chance to join hands with you as you whirl together in the center of the dance floor.
column2: Ia menanti kesempatan bergandengan tangan denganmu sambil berputar bersama di tengah lantai dansa.

column1: =Her longing for you has never faded, and it has filled her dreams.
column2: Kerinduannya padamu tak pernah pudar, dan telah memenuhi mimpinya.

column1: =She loves you, and she wants to shout it from the rooftops.
column2: Ia mencintaimu, dan ingin meneriakkannya dari atap-atap rumah.

column1: =After the noise and bustle dies down, the lamp she keeps burning for you is the sole light in the darkness.
column2: Setelah riuh dan hiruk pikuk mereda, lampu yang terus ia nyalakan untukmu jadi satu-satunya cahaya dalam gelap.

column1: =From this moment on, the same heat and coldness flows in your blood.
column2: Mulai saat ini, panas dan dingin yang sama mengalir dalam darah kalian.

column1: =The rose garden hidden deep in her heart blooms for you alone.
column2: Taman mawar yang tersembunyi di lubuk hatinya mekar hanya untukmu.

column1: =This is proof of her efforts and the basis for her to earn praise.
column2: Ini bukti kerja kerasnya sekaligus dasar baginya untuk mendapat pujian.

column1: =A photo album hidden in the depths of her heart, recording every precious moment spent with you.
column2: Album foto yang tersembunyi di lubuk hatinya, merekam tiap momen berharga bersamamu.

column1: =A delicate mimosa which blossoms solely for your sake.
column2: Putri malu yang rapuh, mekar semata-mata demi dirimu.

column1: =Who says a senior's care and concern can't be selfish? Her otherwise-solid facade of formality crumbles before you alone.
column2: Siapa bilang perhatian seorang senior tak boleh egois? Topeng formalitasnya yang biasanya kokoh runtuh hanya di hadapanmu.

column1: =The once-timid girl can now stand on her own, because she's always headed in the direction where you are.
column2: Gadis yang dulu penakut kini bisa berdiri sendiri, karena ia selalu melangkah ke arah tempatmu berada.

column1: =She pays comprehensive attention to the machines in the garage and the minutiae of life for your sake.
column2: Ia memperhatikan mesin-mesin di garasi sekaligus hal-hal kecil dalam hidup dengan menyeluruh, demi dirimu.

column1: =For the popular imp-kei idol Sharkry, her career and future both shine for you.
column2: Bagi Sharkry, idola imp-kei yang populer, karier dan masa depannya sama-sama bersinar untukmu.

column1: =Even the grumpiest rabbit has a side of her that she only shows to her special someone.
column2: Bahkan kelinci paling pemarah pun punya sisi yang hanya ia tunjukkan pada orang istimewanya.

column1: =To ease your pain and bring you comfort and joy.
column2: Untuk meredakan sakitmu serta membawa kenyamanan dan kegembiraan.

column1: =The footprints left in the snow belong to the one who walked by your side.
column2: Jejak kaki yang tertinggal di salju itu milik orang yang berjalan di sisimu.

column1: =Among her companions, you're her first choice.
column2: Di antara semua rekannya, kau pilihan pertamanya.

column1: =Her heart is pure and innocent, and she shows her feelings for you with her toys.
column2: Hatinya murni dan polos, dan ia menunjukkan perasaannya padamu lewat mainan-mainannya.

column1: =If you're tired, you can lay your head in her embrace and rest.
column2: Kalau kau lelah, kau bisa merebahkan kepalamu dalam pelukannya dan beristirahat.

column1: =There are some shared memories which reside only in your heart and hers.
column2: Ada kenangan bersama yang hanya tersimpan di hatimu dan hatinya.

column1: =Whether she's standing in the light or the darkness, she will always be looking in your direction.
column2: Entah ia berdiri dalam terang atau gelap, ia akan selalu memandang ke arahmu.

column1: =Would that my feelings were a paper plane, and would that it would land on the airstrip of your heart.
column2: Andai perasaanku ini pesawat kertas, dan andai ia mendarat di landasan hatimu.

column1: =She entrusts true freedom into this willingly-accepted bondage.
column2: Ia menitipkan kebebasan sejati ke dalam ikatan yang ia terima dengan rela.

column1: =Every wordless approach is her way of sharing her heartfelt excitement with you.
column2: Tiap kedatangan tanpa kata adalah caranya berbagi kegembiraan yang tulus denganmu.

column1: =The only thing that can patch a hole in a neural cloud is an encounter with a kindred spirit.
column2: Satu-satunya yang bisa menambal lubang di neural cloud adalah perjumpaan dengan jiwa yang sehaluan.

column1: =The mischievous traces she leaves behind announce her claim on you and her victory — even if it's just for a moment.
column2: Jejak jahil yang ia tinggalkan mengumumkan klaimnya atasmu dan kemenangannya — meski cuma sesaat.

column1: =She pulls the trigger, piercing through shattered illusions and reaching the truth.
column2: Ia menarik pelatuk, menembus ilusi yang hancur dan sampai ke kebenaran.

column1: =She says nothing, only watches you gently with her eyes and embracing your feelings.
column2: Ia tak berkata apa-apa, hanya menatapmu lembut dengan matanya sambil merangkul perasaanmu.

column1: =This neural domain was once shrouded in darkness, but your arrival has restored it to its original clarity.
column2: Domain neural ini dulu diselimuti kegelapan, tapi kedatanganmu memulihkannya ke kejernihan semula.

column1: =Her carefree laughter washes over your ears like the howling wind.
column2: Tawanya yang lepas menyapu telingamu bagai angin yang meraung.

column1: =After the dark night has passed, the dawn lights up the sky, reflecting the adamant truth within one's heart.
column2: Setelah malam gelap berlalu, fajar menerangi langit, memantulkan kebenaran yang teguh di dalam hati.

column1: =The most important person in your life deserves your protection 24 hours a day.
column2: Orang terpenting dalam hidupmu layak kau lindungi 24 jam sehari.

column1: =An idol's most perfect song will always be sung for the most important fan.
column2: Lagu paling sempurna seorang idola akan selalu dinyanyikan untuk penggemar yang paling penting.

column1: =The best dreams must include your warmth and voice.
column2: Mimpi terbaik pasti menyertakan kehangatan dan suaramu.

column1: =Love is being conveyed through a Guzheng's song, the meaning known only to the couple.
column2: Cinta disampaikan lewat lagu Guzheng, maknanya hanya diketahui oleh keduanya.

column1: =The wind bears her proud laughter aloft, announcing the victory she will bring you.
column2: Angin mengangkat tawa bangganya tinggi-tinggi, mengumumkan kemenangan yang akan ia persembahkan untukmu.

column1: =Longing knows no borders, and no matter how far apart you are, she will always rush unerringly to your side.
column2: Kerinduan tak mengenal batas, dan sejauh apa pun kalian terpisah, ia akan selalu bergegas tepat ke sisimu.

column1: =Your valiant form is like a star guiding her through the darkness.
column2: Sosokmu yang gagah bagai bintang yang menuntunnya menembus kegelapan.

column1: =Behind her glasses, her eyes have already discerned the truth and your true intentions.
column2: Di balik kacamatanya, matanya sudah menangkap kebenaran dan niat aslimu.

column1: ="Did you say Leva was coming? That's great! That's wonderful!"

column1: ="Come take a load off with me, Comrade."

column1: ="No matter what kind of wish you have, this genius can grant it for you with a simple flex of the mind!"

column1: ="Leva, look at me! Do I look cute in this?"

column1: ="This outfit is very suitable for arctic warfare."

column1: ="Tsk—I can get mad too!"

column1: =What- NO! It, it's not like I'm here because I'm worried about you or anything!
